lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Please keep the folder and its original documents secure.

lines.speaker: Margaret Vale
lines.text: I will. The annotated sheet and the company bank entry stay with me. The originals are not a prize for whoever tells the most dramatic story.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do you need anything else for the comparison?

lines.speaker: Margaret Vale
lines.text: I have sent Leo my permission and copies of the original recent files. Ask Mercer Audio about the voicemail and recording archive for the technical result. I will not improve the evidence by guessing what he found.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Have you preserved the source material and supplied the project?

lines.speaker: Colin Ward
lines.text: Yes. The supplied project and the authorised relay records are available. Have them checked against Margaret’s files.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I will keep your account separate from the independent checks and the accounting query.
